SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.District, s.County, s.`School Type`, s.`Charter School (Y/N)`, s.`Low Grade`, s.`High Grade`, s.`Enrollment (K-12)`, s.`Free Meal Count (K-12)`, s.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, s.`FRPM Count (K-12)`, s.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`, satscores.rtype, satscores.sname, satscores.dname, satscores.cname, satscores.enroll12, satscores.NumTstTakr, satscores.AvgScrRead, satscores.AvgScrMath, satscores.AvgScrWrite, satscores.NumGE1500
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores ON s.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
ORDER BY s.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT `School Name`, `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
FROM satscores
WHERE `School Type` = 'Continuation'
ORDER BY `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
  schools.CDSCode,
  schools.School,
  schools.County,
  schools.District,
  schools.OpenDate,
  schools.StatusType,
  schools.Latitude,
  schools.Longitude,
  schools.Enroll12,
  schools.NumTstTakr,
  schools.AvgScrRead,
  schools.AvgScrMath,
  schools.AvgScrWrite,
  schools.NumGE1500,
  frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`,
  CASE 
    WHEN frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 75 THEN 'High FRPM'
    WHEN frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` BETWEEN 50 AND 75 THEN 'Medium FRPM'
    ELSE 'Low FRPM'
  END AS FRPM_Ranking
FROM 
  schools
JOIN 
  frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
JOIN 
  satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE 
  schools.Charter = 1 AND schools.County = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
ORDER BY 
  frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` DESC;

SELECT 
  schools.School,
  schools.Street,
  schools.City,
  schools.Zip,
  schools.State,
  schools.MailStreet,
  schools.MailCity,
  schools.MailZip,
  schools.MailState,
  schools.Website,
  schools.Enrollment,
  schools.NumTstTakr,
  schools.AvgScrRead,
  schools.AvgScrMath,
  schools.AvgScrWrite,
  schools.NumGE1500,
  CASE 
    WHEN schools.Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12) > 70 AND schools.NumGE1500 / schools.NumTstTakr > 0.2 THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM'
    WHEN schools.Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12) < 30 AND schools.NumGE1500 / schools.NumTstTakr < 0.1 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM'
    ELSE 'Expected performance'
  END AS Performance
FROM 
  schools
JOIN 
  satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE 
  schools.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 0
  AND schools.Enrollment > 100
  AND schools.`FRPM Count (K-12)` = (SELECT MAX(`FRPM Count (K-12)`) FROM schools WHERE `Charter School (Y/N)` = 0 AND Enrollment > 100)

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.Charter = 1 AND schools.FundingType = 'Direct Charter' AND schools.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.District, s.County, s.Enroll12, s.NumTstTakr, s.AvgScrRead, s.AvgScrMath, s.AvgScrWrite, s.NumGE1500, f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.`Virtual` = 'F' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400
ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.District, s.County, s.StatusType, s.GSoffered, s.GSserved, s.`Virtual`, s.Magnet, s.Latitude, s.Longitude, s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1, s.AdmEmail1, s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2, s.AdmEmail2, s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3, s.AdmEmail3, s.LastUpdate, satscores.enroll12, satscores.NumTstTakr, satscores.AvgScrRead, satscores.AvgScrMath, satscores.AvgScrWrite, satscores.NumGE1500, frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`, frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`, frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ON s.CDSCode = satscores.cds
JOIN frpm ON s.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND satscores.NumTstTakr > 500
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores)

SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.County, s.District, s.SchoolType, s.FRPMCountK12, s.PercentEligibleFRPMK12, ss.NumTstTakr, ss.AvgScrRead, ss.AvgScrMath, ss.AvgScrWrite, ss.NumGE1500
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
ORDER BY f.FRPMCountK12 DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds 
WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 560 AND schools.FundingType = 'Directly Charter-Funded';

SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.County, s.District, s.State, s.Zip, s.Latitude, s.Longitude, s.GSoffered, s.GSserved, s.`Virtual`, s.Magnet, s.Charter, s.FREE, s.REDUCED, s.ENROLL, s.NumTstTakr, s.AvgScrRead, s.AvgScrMath, s.AvgScrWrite, s.NumGE1500
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.NumTstTakr > 10
ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.County,
    s.School,
    s.Enrollment,
    s.`Free Meal Count`,
    s.`Percent (%) Eligible Free`,
    s.`Charter School (Y/N)`,
    s.AvgScrRead,
    s.AvgScrMath,
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    s.NumGE1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 75 THEN 'High'
        WHEN s.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` BETWEEN 50 AND 75 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS FRPM_Level,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY s.Enrollment DESC) AS Enrollment_Rank,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County, FRPM_Level ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS SAT_Rank
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
    s.Enrollment > 500
    AND (s.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 60 OR ss.NumGE1500 > 30)
GROUP BY 
    s.County, s.School, s.Enrollment, s.`Free Meal Count`, s.`Percent (%) Eligible Free`, s.`Charter School (Y/N)`, s.AvgScrRead, s.AvgScrMath, s.AvgScrWrite, s.NumGE1500, FRPM_Level
ORDER BY 
    s.County, Enrollment_Rank, SAT_Rank;

FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.FundingType = 'Directly funded' AND schools.County = 'Fresno County' AND satscores.NumTstTakr <= 250

SELECT schools.CDSCode, schools.School, schools.Street, schools.City, schools.Zip, schools.State, schools.Phone, schools.Website, schools.OpenDate, schools.ClosedDate, schools.Charter, schools.Enrollment, schools.Percent_Eligible_FRPM, satscores.AvgScrMath
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Active' AND satscores.NumTstTakr >= 10
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT schools.School) AS Total_Schools,
    AVG(schools.Enrollment) AS Average_Enrollment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN schools.Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Charter_Schools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN schools.Charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Non_Charter_Schools,
    AVG(frpm.Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)) AS Average_Poverty_Rate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT schools.District) AS Number_of_Districts,
    AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) AS Average_SAT_Read_Score,
    AVG(satscores.AvgScrMath) AS Average_SAT_Math_Score,
    AVG(satscores.AvgScrWrite) AS Average_SAT_Write_Score,
    MAX(schools.Enrollment) AS Largest_School_Enrollment,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN frpm.Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12) > 0.75 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS High_Poverty_Schools
FROM 
    schools
JOIN 
    frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    schools.County = 'Amador County' AND schools.School Type = 'High School';

SELECT AVG(Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)) AS AvgFreeMealPct,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NumCharter,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NumNonCharter,
       AVG(AvgScrRead) AS AvgSATRead,
       AVG(AvgScrMath) AS AvgSATMath,
       AVG(AvgScrWrite) AS AvgSATWrite,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 600 THEN 1 END) AS VeryHighFreeMeal,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` BETWEEN 500 AND 600 THEN 1 END) AS HighFreeMeal,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` < 500 THEN 1 END) AS ModerateFreeMeal
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500 AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700 AND County = 'Los Angeles'

SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.County, s.District, s.School, s.enroll12, s.NumTstTakr
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY ss.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.StreetAbr, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.1
AND sa.NumGE1500 > 0;

SELECT schools.School, schools.EducationalOptionType
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.County = 'Riverside' AND satscores.AvgScrMath > 400
GROUP BY schools.School
HAVING AVG(satscores.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.SchoolType = 'High School'
AND s.County = 'Monterey'
AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT s.School, s.Communication, AVG(ss.AvgScrWrite) AS AverageScore
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.OpenDate > '1991-01-01' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-12-31'
GROUP BY s.School, s.Communication;

SELECT 
  c.gender,
  CASE 
    WHEN c.birth_date < '1993-01-01' THEN 'Senior'
    WHEN c.birth_date BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '1973-01-01' THEN 'Middle-aged'
    ELSE 'Young'
  END AS age_group,
  d.A2 AS region,
  COUNT(*) AS num_accounts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expenses
FROM 
  client c
  JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
  a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4, d.A5, d.A6, d.A7, d.A8, d.A9, d.A10, d.A11, d.A12, d.A13, d.A14, d.A15, d.A16,
       COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payments,
       COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_transaction_balance,
       COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount,
       COUNT(c.card_id) AS card_count
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id

  SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_balance,
  CASE 
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 10 THEN 'High Activity'
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 0 THEN 'Loan Customer'
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) > 10 THEN 'Active Customer'
    ELSE 'Regular Customer'
  END AS customer_category
FROM 
  account a
  JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
  d.A2 = 'Prachatice'
GROUP BY 
  a.account_id, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2
ORDER BY 
  net_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    c.gender, 
    c.birth_date, 
    d.A2, 
    d.A3, 
    d.A11, 
    d.A12, 
    l.amount, 
    l.duration, 
    l.payments, 
    l.status, 
    CASE 
        WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 'Running - Issues'
        WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN 'Finished - Issues'
        ELSE 'Running - OK'
    END AS status_description,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.A2 ORDER BY l.amount DESC) AS loan_rank
FROM 
    loan l
JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    l.loan_id = 4990;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS region,
    a.account_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    c.district_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN d.A11 > 1000000 THEN 'High Income'
        WHEN d.A11 > 500000 THEN 'Medium Income'
        ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_classification,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS savings_ratio,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
    MAX(l.amount) AS max_loan_amount,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3 ORDER BY MAX(l.amount) DESC) AS region_rank
FROM 
    account a

    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    l.amount > 300000
    AND d.A11 > (SELECT AVG(A11) FROM district)
    AND (SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) > 0

    a.account_id

    max_loan_amount DESC

    100;

SELECT A2, COUNT(*) AS female_account_holders
FROM district
JOIN client ON district.district_id = client.district_id
WHERE gender = 'F'
GROUP BY A2
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS withdrawals
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A3 = 'South Bohemia') 
AND client_id NOT IN (SELECT client_id FROM disp WHERE type = 'credit card');

SELECT district.A3, COUNT(*) AS active_loans
FROM district
JOIN account ON district.district_id = account.district_id
JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
WHERE loan.status = 'C'
GROUP BY district.A3
ORDER BY active_loans DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan
WHERE account_id IN (
  SELECT account_id
  FROM disp
  WHERE client_id IN (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'M'
  )
);

SELECT A2, A13
FROM district
ORDER BY A13 DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region, d.A8 AS population, d.A16 AS crimes_1996, 
       (d.A16 - d.A15) / d.A15 * 100 AS percentage_increase, COUNT(a.account_id) AS accounts_opened
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district)
GROUP BY d.district_id

SELECT 
    AVG(balance) AS avg_negative_balance,
    MAX(amount) AS max_withdrawal_amount,
    AVG(COUNT(card_id)) OVER () AS avg_cards_per_account,
    COUNT(DISTINCT card_id) AS total_gold_cards,
    AVG(DATEDIFF('2000-01-01', birth_date)) AS avg_owner_age,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN client_id END) AS male_owners,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN client_id END) AS female_owners
FROM 
    account
JOIN 
    disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN 
    client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN 
    card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
JOIN 
    trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE 
    frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
    AND balance < 0
    AND operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan.account_id)
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
AND loan.amount >= 250000
AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
AND loan.status = 'APPROVED';

SELECT 
  AVG(loan.amount - (loan.payments * loan.duration)) AS avg_remaining_debt,
  AVG(CASE WHEN client.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_percentage,
  AVG(CASE WHEN client.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_percentage,
  AVG(julianday('now') - julianday(client.birth_date)) AS avg_age,
  COUNT(DISTINCT card.card_id) AS card_ownership,
  COUNT(DISTINCT trans.trans_id) AS transaction_activity,
  AVG(account.balance) AS avg_account_balance
FROM 
  loan
  JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
  JOIN client ON account.client_id = client.client_id
  LEFT JOIN card ON account.account_id = card.account_id
  LEFT JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE 
  loan.status IN ('C', 'D') AND
  account.district_id = 1

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(c.client_id) AS total_clients, d.A15 AS crime_count, COUNT(a.account_id) AS total_accounts, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COUNT(ca.card_id) AS total_cards, AVG(disp_count) AS avg_dispositions, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS clients_with_loans, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.birth_date BETWEEN DATE('now', '-30 years') AND DATE('now', '-1 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS young_clients,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.birth_date BETWEEN DATE('now', '-50 years') AND DATE('now', '-30 years') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS middle_aged_clients,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.birth_date BETWEEN DATE('now', '-100 years') AND DATE('now', '-50 years') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS senior_clients
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN account a ON c.client_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN card ca ON a.account_id = ca.account_id
LEFT JOIN disp ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
GROUP BY d.district_id
ORDER BY d.A15 DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;

SELECT c.gender, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND d.card_id IN (SELECT card_id FROM card WHERE type = 'gold')
GROUP BY c.gender
HAVING AVG(t.balance) > 1000;

SELECT 
    COUNT(account_id) AS total_accounts,
    AVG(COUNT(trans_id)) AS avg_transactions_per_account,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals,
    AVG(MAX(balance)) AS avg_max_balance,
    COUNT(DISTINCT card_id) AS total_cards_issued,
    COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS total_loans_issued,
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN loan_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(loan_id)) AS active_loan_percentage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS unique_account_owners
FROM 
    account
JOIN 
    disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN 
    client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN 
    district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    card ON account.account_id = card.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
WHERE 
    district.A2 = 'Pisek'
GROUP BY 
    district.district_id;

SELECT d.A2
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000 AND t.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d2 ON c.district_id = d2.district_id
JOIN `order` o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
WHERE d2.A2 = 'Pisek' AND o.k_symbol = 'SIPO';

SELECT 
  a.account_id,
  COUNT(c.card_id) AS gold_cards,
  d.A2 AS location,
  AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
  COUNT(l.loan_id) AS num_loans,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_good_loans,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_bad_loans
FROM 
  account a
  JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
  c.type = 'gold'
GROUP BY 
  a.account_id, d.A2
ORDER BY 
  avg_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS Region,
    d.A3 AS District,
    c.gender AS Gender,
    c.type AS CardType,
    AVG(t.amount) AS AverageTransactionAmount,
    SUM(t.amount) AS TotalSpending,
    (SUM(t.amount) / d.A10) AS SpendingToSalaryRatio
FROM 
    trans t
JOIN 
    account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    t.date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
    AND t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
GROUP BY 
    d.A2, d.A3, c.gender, c.type
ORDER BY 
    d.A2, d.A3, c.gender, c.type;

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYBER KARTOU'
AND t.amount < (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM trans WHERE YEAR(date) = 1998)

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4, d.A5, d.A6, d.A7, d.A8, d.A9, d.A10, d.A11, d.A12, d.A13, d.A14, d.A15, d.A16,
       SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_loans,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS num_transactions,
       (SUM(t.amount) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'DEBIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(t.amount) * 100 AS savings_rate,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC) AS loan_rank
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.type = 'OWNER' AND l.status IN ('A', 'B')
GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4, d.A5, d.A6, d.A7, d.A8, d.A9, d.A10, d.A11, d.A12, d.A13, d.A14, d.A15, d.A16
ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
  d.A3 AS district,
  CASE 
    WHEN c.birth_date > '1980-01-01' THEN 'Young'
    WHEN c.birth_date BETWEEN '1960-01-01' AND '1980-01-01' THEN 'Middle-aged'
    ELSE 'Senior'
  END AS age_group,
  COUNT(*) AS num_accounts,
  AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_activity,
  SUM(t.amount) AS total_income,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'expense' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
  SUM(t.amount) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'expense' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_balance,
  AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS active_loan_rate
FROM 
  client c
  JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
  c.gender = 'F' AND d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
GROUP BY 
  d.A3, age_group

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4, d.A5, d.A6, d.A7, d.A8, d.A9, d.A10, d.A11, d.A12, d.A13, d.A14, d.A15, d.A16,
       GROUP_CONCAT(t.type) AS transaction_types, GROUP_CONCAT(t.operation) AS transaction_operations, GROUP_CONCAT(t.amount) AS transaction_amounts,
       GROUP_CONCAT(l.status) AS loan_statuses, GROUP_CONCAT(l.amount) AS loan_amounts, GROUP_CONCAT(l.duration) AS loan_durations,
       CASE
           WHEN AVG(t.amount) > 1000 THEN 'High'
           WHEN AVG(t.amount) > 500 THEN 'Medium'
           ELSE 'Low'
       END AS customer_priority
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
GROUP BY c.client_id;

SELECT d.A11, d.A12, d.A13, d.A14, d.A15, d.A16
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A12 > 8000 AND d.A12 <= 9000
AND a.type != 'OWNER'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT 
  d.A2 AS District,
  COUNT(t.trans_id) AS TotalWithdrawals,
  SUM(t.amount) AS TotalWithdrawalAmount,
  AVG(t.amount) AS WithdrawalPerCapita,
  CASE 
    WHEN AVG(t.amount) > 2.0 THEN 'High'
    WHEN AVG(t.amount) BETWEEN 1.0 AND 2.0 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END AS UnemploymentLevel
FROM 
  trans t
  JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
  t.type = 'VYDAJ'
GROUP BY 
  d.A2
ORDER BY 
  TotalWithdrawalAmount DESC;

SELECT AVG(A15) AS average_crimes
FROM district
WHERE A15 > 4000
AND district_id IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT district_id
  FROM account
  WHERE date >= '1997-01-01'
);

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS classic_credit_card_holders, AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS average_account_balance, AVG(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loan_performance, AVG(d.A10) AS district_salary, AVG(d.A11) AS unemployment_rate
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp d2 ON c.client_id = d2.client_id
JOIN account a ON d2.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d2.type = 'OWNER' AND d2.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM card WHERE type = 'CLASSIC')
GROUP BY d.A2;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN client.birth_date >= DATE('now', '-30 years') THEN 'Young'
    WHEN client.birth_date >= DATE('now', '-50 years') THEN 'Middle-aged'
    ELSE 'Senior'
  END AS age_group,
  COUNT(*) AS total_clients,
  SUM(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN trans.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
  SUM(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN trans.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expenses,
  SUM(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN trans.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN trans.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_income,
  COUNT(DISTINCT loan.loan_id) AS total_loans,
  SUM(CASE WHEN loan.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
  SUM(CASE WHEN loan.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans
FROM 
  client
  JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
  JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
  JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
  LEFT JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
WHERE 
  district.A2 = 'Prague'
  AND client.gender = 'M'
GROUP BY 
  age_group;

SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card WHERE type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01') / 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card WHERE type = 'gold') * 100 AS overall_percentage,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card WHERE type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' AND district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A3 = 'region1')) / 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card WHERE type = 'gold' AND district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A3 = 'region1')) * 100 AS region1_percentage,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card WHERE type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' AND district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A3 = 'region2')) / 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card WHERE type = 'gold' AND district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A3 = 'region2')) * 100 AS region2_percentage,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card WHERE type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' AND district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A3 = 'region3')) / 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card WHERE type = 'gold' AND district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A3 = 'region3')) * 100 AS region3_percentage
FROM 
  card

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4, d.A5, d.A6, d.A7, d.A8, d.A9, d.A10, d.A11, d.A12, d.A13, d.A14, d.A15, d.A16, l.amount, t.savings_rate, d.unemployment_rate
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)
AND d.unemployment_rate > 1.0

SELECT 
    d.A15 AS crimes_1995,
    d.A16 AS crimes_1996,
    (d.A16 - d.A15) / d.A15 * 100 AS crime_change_percentage,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count,
    (d.A15 + d.A16) / 2 AS average_crime_rate,
    (d.A15 + d.A16) / 2 / (SELECT AVG(A15 + A16) FROM district) * 100 AS crime_ranking
FROM 
    district d
JOIN 
    account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    a.account_id = 532
GROUP BY 
    d.district_id;

SELECT d.A10 AS economic_ranking, a.date AS transaction_date, a.type AS transaction_type, a.operation AS transaction_operation, a.amount AS transaction_amount, a.balance AS transaction_balance, a.k_symbol AS transaction_k_symbol, a.bank AS transaction_bank, a.account AS transaction_account, c.gender AS client_gender, c.birth_date AS client_birth_date, c.district_id AS client_district_id, l.date AS loan_date, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration AS loan_duration, l.payments AS loan_payments, l.status AS loan_status, o.bank_to AS order_bank_to, o.account_to AS order_account_to, o.amount AS order_amount, o.k_symbol AS order_k_symbol
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN `order` o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
WHERE o.order_id = 33333;

SELECT t.*
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 3356 AND t.operation = 'VYBER';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' 
AND account_id IN (
    SELECT account_id 
    FROM loan 
    WHERE amount < 200000
);

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4, d.A5, d.A6, d.A7, d.A8, d.A9, d.A10, d.A11, d.A12, d.A13, d.A14, d.A15, d.A16,
       cc.card_id, cc.type, cc.issued,
       t.trans_id, t.date, t.type, t.operation, t.amount, t.balance, t.k_symbol, t.bank, t.account,
       l.loan_id, l.date, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status,
       CASE
           WHEN cc.type = 'Gold' THEN 'Premium'
           WHEN cc.type = 'Classic' AND julianday('now') - julianday(cc.issued) > 1825 THEN 'Long-term Classic'
           ELSE 'Standard'
       END AS customer_segment,
       COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cc ON d.disp_id = cc.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON c.client_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON c.client_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 13539
GROUP BY c.client_id, cc.card_id, t.trans_id, l.loan_id;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS region,
    l.loan_id,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_balance,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS clients_in_same_region
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    client c ON a.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    c.client_id = 3541
GROUP BY 
    a.account_id, d.A2, l.loan_id
ORDER BY 
    transaction_count DESC;

SELECT district.A2, COUNT(account.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.status = 'A'
GROUP BY district.A2
ORDER BY num_accounts DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4, d.A5, d.A6, d.A7, d.A8, d.A9, d.A10, d.A11, d.A12, d.A13, d.A14, d.A15, d.A16, o.bank_to, o.account_to, o.amount, o.k_symbol, l.status, t.type, t.operation, t.amount, t.balance, t.k_symbol, t.bank, t.account, COUNT(c.card_id) AS num_cards
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN `order` o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN card c2 ON c.client_id = c2.disp_id
WHERE o.order_id = 32423
GROUP BY c.client_id;
SELECT * FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE district_id = 5);

SELECT 
    COUNT(account_id) AS total_accounts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incoming_transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_transactions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS total_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans,
    AVG(balance) AS average_balance,
    COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS total_clients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_clients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_clients
FROM 
    account
JOIN 
    disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN 
    client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN 
    district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE 
    district.A2 = 'Jesenik';

SELECT client_id
FROM client
WHERE client_id IN (
  SELECT client_id
  FROM disp
  WHERE type = 'junior credit card'
  AND disp_id IN (
    SELECT disp_id
    FROM card
    WHERE issued >= '1997-01-01'
  )
);

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM client
WHERE district_id IN (
  SELECT district_id
  FROM district
  WHERE A11 > 10000
)

SELECT (SUM(l.amount_1997) - SUM(l.amount_1996)) / SUM(l.amount_1996) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id

SELECT 
  (CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) + CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, 10, 3) AS INTEGER) / 1000) - 
  (CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver_time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver_time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) + CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver_time, 10, 3) AS INTEGER) / 1000) 
  / 
  (CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver_time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver_time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) + CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver_time, 10, 3) AS INTEGER) / 1000) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM 
  (
    SELECT 
      r.time AS last_driver_time, 
      q1 AS champion_time
    FROM 
      results r
      JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceId = q.raceId AND r.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN COUNT(ID) WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' > COUNT(ID) WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 'in-patient'
    ELSE 'outpatient'
  END AS "More Common",
  ABS(COUNT(ID) WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' - COUNT(ID) WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-') AS "Deviation"
FROM 
  Patient;

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(ID) WHERE year(Birthday) > '1930' AND SEX = 'F') / 
    (COUNT(ID) WHERE SEX = 'F') * 100
  ) AS percentage
FROM 
  Patient;

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS Outpatient, COUNT(ID) AS Inpatient
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Admission = '-'
UNION ALL

FROM Patient

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' AND UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' AND UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM
  Patient

SELECT Segment, 
       MAX(PercentageIncrease) AS MaxPercentageIncrease, 
       MIN(PercentageIncrease) AS MinPercentageIncrease
FROM (
  SELECT Segment, 
         (Consumption2013 - Consumption2012) / Consumption2012 * 100 AS PercentageIncrease
  FROM (
    SELECT ym1.CustomerID, ym1.Date, ym1.Consumption AS Consumption2013, ym2.Consumption AS Consumption2012
    FROM yearmonth ym1
    JOIN yearmonth ym2 ON ym1.CustomerID = ym2.CustomerID AND ym1.Date LIKE '2013%' AND ym2.Date LIKE '2012%'
    JOIN customers c ON ym1.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  ) AS ConsumptionData
) AS PercentageIncreaseData
GROUP BY Segment;

FROM customers c

ORDER BY SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;
